items.description: Tenant must pay Landlord's actual attorneys' fees for lease consultation on Transfers or Rent collection, to the extent they exceed the stated threshold.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to pay to Landlord its actual attorneys’ fees whether suit be brought or not to the extent such fees exceed $1,000.00.
items.trigger: if it should otherwise be necessary or proper for Landlord to consult an attorney concerning this Lease for the review of instruments evidencing a proposed Transfer or for the purpose of collecting Rent

items.description: In any proceeding over enforcement, construction or interpretation of the Lease, the losing party pays the winning party's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.
items.span_text: then the non-prevailing party shall pay the prevailing party’s reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs
items.trigger: If either Landlord or Tenant initiates any litigation, mediation, arbitration or other proceeding regarding the enforcement, construction or interpretation of this Lease

items.description: Landlord and Tenant must execute a short form Memo of Lease within ten business days after the Effective Date, and Tenant must record it in the Middlesex County real estate records.
items.span_text: a short form memorandum of this Lease (the “Memo of Lease”) in the form attached hereto as Exhibit “K” shall be executed by Landlord and Tenant within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date and recorded by Tenant in the real estate records of Middlesex County, Massachusetts.

items.description: Tenant and anyone acting for it must not record the Lease itself.
items.span_text: Neither Tenant nor any person or entity acting through, under or on behalf of Tenant shall record or cause the recordation of this Lease

items.description: Except in emergencies, Landlord must use reasonable efforts to minimize disruption to Tenant when entering the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: Landlord shall use reasonable efforts to minimize disruption of Tenant’s business or occupancy during such entries.

items.description: Notices under the Lease must be in writing and delivered by hand, overnight courier, or e-mail with a confirming courier copy.
items.span_text: Any notice which may or shall be given under the provisions of this Lease shall be in writing
